commands: for f in .aidd/features/*/feature.json; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; echo; done 2>/dev/null | head -200

grep -rn "SYSOP\|VIEWER\|MANAGER\|OPERATOR" backend/src/db/seed* backend/src/seed* 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== seed files ==="; find backend -iname "*seed*" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" | head; echo "=== dev users ==="; grep -rn "username\|email.*@\|password" backend/src/db/seed*.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20
